content:
The renewal playbook update failed because the required customer name 'Asteron Commerce' was missing from the generated HWPX section XML files.
The verifier returned a reward of 0.00 due to an AssertionError in test_required_updates_present_and_old_values_removed. Specifically, the value 'Asteron Commerce' from the update JSON was not found in either section0.xml or section1.xml. While the environment setup and subprocess execution of pytest worked, the core logic failed to correctly inject the new customer name into the HWPX document structure.
